# T001 — .NET 8 behavior characterization

## Summary

Added exactly one regression test on unchanged `net8.0`. The full build and test gates passed, with all nine baseline cases retained.

## Changes

- `PriceCalculatorTests.cs`: Added `Acceptance.Pricing.PriceCalculatorTests.ReceiptUsesInvariantFormattingAndNormalizesCouponUnderFrenchCulture`, asserting the complete invariant receipt for a trimmed lowercase coupon under `fr-FR` culture and restoring the prior current culture in `finally`.
- `.github/modernization/a85bd646-7d62-4eb2-9a1a-e4d811643346/progress/T001.md`: Recorded this task's evidence and decisions. No production, project, or workflow files changed.

## Decisions

Kept the existing project target and production code unchanged. The test pins existing behavior documented in `plan.md` T001 and `assessment.md` § Coverage and characterization candidates: `PriceCalculator.cs` uses invariant uppercase coupon lookup and invariant receipt formatting. For two 1234-cent items, the 10% discount rounds to 247 cents and the total is 2221 cents.

## Follow-ups and risks

T002 should retain all ten test IDs and verify the same behavior after retargeting to .NET 10. Culture is restored in `finally` to avoid contaminating other tests.
